name: Hoshi no Oka Gakuen Monogatari: Gakuensai
original_name: 星の丘学園物語 学園祭
source: Our hero Kanata Muriya (name changeable) has just transferred to a new school and he has one month to prepare for the school festival. During that time, he'll have to make sure the festival is a success, while interacting and developing new relationships with his classmates.
